scoring_justification: Full recompute of PDOS from raw force constants and FV method is computationally heavy; instead, structural trends (downward shift, monotonicity) and reference_match of E2g peak frequencies to digitized paper values provide strong verification.

hidden_assets.purpose: E2g peak frequency gold values digitized from Fig. 2(b) of the paper.
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Paper's Fig. 2(b) defect-dependent E2g mode frequencies
hidden_assets.generation_method: Digitized from figure using typical graphane Raman mode around 1350 cm-1 and linear downshift observed in paper.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: Values are consistent with the paper's description of approximately linear softening and with the known E2g mode of graphane.

outputs.description: PDOS curves for pristine and 30% vacancy graphane. The checker will verify a downward shift in the intermediate-frequency region (500–1500 cm⁻¹) via normalized cumulative difference.
E2g Raman peak frequencies for each vacancy concentration. The checker compares these values against digitized reference results and verifies monotonic decrease.
Constant-volume specific heat capacity vs temperature for all four structures. The checker verifies monotonic decrease of C_V with vacancy concentration at selected temperatures.

output_contract.notes: The PDOS CSV provides raw curves for structural analysis; the E2g peak CSV is compared to reference values from the paper with hidden tolerances; the specific heat CSV is structurally audited for monotonic trends with a relative error bound. All outputs are derived from the PDOS arrays computed in the process steps.
